## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Niedersachsen lights up on the map of Germany.
> Niedersachsen | Landeshauptstadt Hannover

[dramatic] [[Niedersachsen]], Lower Saxony, in the north-west, runs from the North Sea coast to the Harz mountains. Its capital is Hanover, and Volkswagen has its headquarters in Wolfsburg.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Lower Saxony, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> NIEDERSACHSEN

## On the map

{Q388}

> SCENE (question): Question card #388. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Niedersachsen?]] Which federal state is Lower Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[1]]. Number one: the large state in the north-west.


{Q387}

> SCENE (question): Question card #387. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Niedersachsen heißt …]] The state capital of Lower Saxony is...

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Hannover.]] The other three are real cities in Lower Saxony, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q385}

> SCENE (question): Question card #385. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Niedersachsen?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Lower Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[schwarz-rot-gold]]. Black, red and gold, like the German flag, with the white horse on it.


{Q381}

> SCENE (question): Question card #381. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Bundesland Niedersachsen?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the federal state of Lower Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 3]], picture three: a white horse, rearing, on a red shield.


## How it's run

{Q382}

> SCENE (question): Question card #382. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Niedersachsen?]] Which of these is a district (Landkreis) in Lower Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ammerland]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Rhein-Sieg-Kreis]] is in [[Nordrhein-Westfalen]], [[Nordfriesland]] is in [[Schleswig-Holstein]], and [[Vogtlandkreis]] is in [[Sachsen]].


{Q383}

> SCENE (question): Question card #383. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Niedersachsen gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament (Landtag) in Lower Saxony elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q384}

> SCENE (question): Question card #384. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Niedersachsen bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] From what age are you allowed to vote in local elections in Lower Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[16]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from sixteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q389}

> SCENE (question): Question card #389. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Niedersachsen?]] What is the title of the head of government in Lower Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q390}

> SCENE (question): Question card #390. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Niedersachsen nicht?]] Which minister does Lower Saxony not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q386}

> SCENE (question): Question card #386. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Niedersachsen über politische Themen informieren?]] Where in Lower Saxony can you find information on political topics?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Hannover, schwarz-rot-gold, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Hannover]]. [[schwarz-rot-gold]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
